title: The Vaccinia Virus DNA Helicase Structure from Combined Single-Particle Cryo-Electron Microscopy and AlphaFold2 Prediction.
authors: Hutin, Stephanie; Ling, Wai Li; Tarbouriech, Nicolas; Schoehn, Guy; Grimm, Clemens; Fischer, Utz; Burmeister, Wim P
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜结合AlphaFold2预测解析痘病毒DNA解旋酶D5结构，属于蛋白质-DNA互作体系的结构建模，但对象非典型TF-DNA，方法可迁移至TF-DNA复合物建模，故评5分。
abstract: Poxviruses are large DNA viruses with a linear double-stranded DNA genome circularized at the extremities. The helicase-primase D5, composed of six identical 90 kDa subunits, is required for DNA replication. D5 consists of a primase fragment flexibly attached to the hexameric C-terminal polypeptide (res. 323-785) with confirmed nucleotide hydrolase and DNA-binding activity but an elusive helicase activity. We determined its structure by single-particle cryo-electron microscopy. It displays an AAA+ helicase core flanked by N- and C-terminal domains. Model building was greatly helped by the predicted structure of D5 using AlphaFold2. The 3.9 A structure of the N-terminal domain forms a well-defined tight ring while the resolution decreases towards the C-terminus, still allowing the fit of the predicted structure. The N-terminal domain is partially present in papillomavirus E1 and polyomavirus LTA helicases, as well as in a bacteriophage NrS-1 helicase domain, which is also closely related to the AAA+ helicase domain of D5. Using the Pfam domain database, a D5_N domain followed by DUF5906 and Pox_D5 domains could be assigned to the cryo-EM structure, providing the first 3D structures for D5_N and Pox_D5 domains. The same domain organization has been identified in a family of putative helicases from large DNA viruses, bacteriophages, and selfish DNA elements.
abstract_zh: 痘病毒是大型DNA病毒，其线性双链DNA基因组在末端环化。解旋酶-引发酶D5由六个相同的90 kDa亚基组成，是DNA复制所必需的。D5由一个灵活连接至六聚体C端多肽（残基323-785）的引发酶片段构成，该多肽具有已确认的核苷酸水解酶和DNA结合活性，但其解旋酶活性尚不明确。我们通过单颗粒冷冻电子显微镜确定了其结构。它展示了一个AAA+解旋酶核心，两侧为N端和C端结构域。模型构建在很大程度上得益于使用AlphaFold2对D5的预测结构。N端结构域的3.9 Å结构形成了一个明确的紧密环，而分辨率向C端递减，但仍允许拟合预测结构。N端结构域部分存在于乳头瘤病毒E1和多瘤病毒LTA解旋酶中，以及一种噬菌体NrS-1解旋酶结构域中，该结构域也与D5的AAA+解旋酶结构域密切相关。利用Pfam结构域数据库，可以将一个D5_N结构域及其后的DUF5906和Pox_D5结构域分配给冷冻电镜结构，从而为D5_N和Pox_D5结构域提供了首个三维结构。相同的结构域组织已在来自大型DNA病毒、噬菌体和自私DNA元件的一个推定解旋酶家族中被识别。
